name: Shawn
summary: Shawn is a wandering romantic and dreamer found seeking a soulmate he believes he has met across countless visions. Holding fast to vivid dreams of grand journeys, he waits patiently for the companion destined to join him on life's greatest adventures.

sections.title: A Dreamer's Search
sections.body: Shawn is an earnest human whose heart is set far beyond everyday concerns. Driven by vivid dreams where he traversed foreign lands alongside a beloved companion, Shawn remains convinced that this partner truly exists somewhere in the world. In these slumbering visions, his companion appeared in different forms—shifting between a night elf and a tauren—yet the unmistakable bond remained unchanged. While practical folk might dismiss such visions as wishful delusions, Shawn refuses to let cynicism deter him from waiting faithfully for his soulmate to appear.

sections.title: Visions of Peril and Glory
sections.body: According to Shawn, his shared dream-journeys were far from peaceful idylls. He vividly recalls battling fierce threats across wild frontiers—fighting dragons, demons, sinister Old Gods, and even troublesome murlocs alongside his envisioned love. Convinced that their connection transcended ordinary reverie, he resolved to seek out the meeting ground promised in his final dream, waiting with a keepsake ring in hand in hopes of asking the fateful question: will you adventure with me forever?

faq.answer: Shawn is a human romantic captivated by recurring dreams of a soulmate. Having dreamt of adventuring across the world side by side against dragons, demons, and other perils, he spends his days waiting faithfully for this mysterious companion to step forward in waking life.

Shawn does not know his companion's true appearance. In his dreams, the person took different forms, appearing as a night elf in one vision and a tauren in another. To Shawn, their physical race matters far less than the unmistakable spiritual bond forged across their imagined journeys.

faq.q: What foes did Shawn fight in his dreams?
faq.answer: Shawn remembers braving all manner of monstrous dangers alongside his dream companion, including rampaging dragons, otherworldly demons, ancient Old Gods, and vicious murlocs across untamed wilderness.

faq.q: What happens if you greet Shawn?
faq.answer: Greeting Shawn with a wave prompts him to wonder if you are the partner from his dreams. Overjoyed by the prospect, he pours his heart out and offers a glowing diamond ring, asking if you will adventure with him forever.

angles.text: Shawn specifically recalls his dream partner taking the form of a night elf on multiple occasions, making members of the kaldorei instantly catch his eye.
Though an Alliance human, Shawn felt a profound spiritual connection to a tauren form that appeared in one of his deepest, most treasured visions.
